description: A Christmas journey on the Orient Express leads into 2026 questions on mythology, theatre, horror, Scottish history and other eclectic subjects as Clarkson continues putting six contestants at a time through the Millionaire chair.

s11e01.description: The Orient Express carries the Christmas episode into a world of luxury rail travel and cultural legend. The question set ranges elsewhere, but few names can match a famous train for combining geography, history and instant atmosphere.

s11e02.description: The Theatre of the Absurd lends the episode a cultural label that could occasionally describe quiz television itself. Drama and philosophy meet a varied ladder where logic remains available, merely not always at the moment it would be useful.

s11e03.description: Cassandra brings the curse of true prophecy and universal disbelief into the hot seat. Greek mythology supplies a concept almost cruelly suited to multiple choice: being right is useful only if you can persuade yourself to trust it.

s11e04.description: The Overlook Hotel checks horror cinema into the question ladder with suitably ominous hospitality. Film knowledge gives the episode its memorable location while the surrounding trivia offers plenty of other corridors in which certainty can get lost.

s11e05.description: Medusa brings snakes, stone and one of mythology’s most recognisable faces into the quiz. Ancient legend supplies the episode’s visual centre while the ladder sensibly avoids making eye contact and moves on to other forms of danger.

s11e06.description: Caledonia gives Scotland its poetic old name and the episode a compact historical identity. Geography, language and culture converge around a word that sounds familiar long before most people are asked to define it precisely.
